raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Cantilever root support",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 calls the structure a cantilever and mentions fixed-boundary corners, but never specifies the exact clamped node set. The setup is assigned to unavailable Fig. 3.",
      "readings": [
        "Clamp both displacement components at every node on the left edge.",
        "Clamp both displacement components only at the two left corner nodes.",
        "Clamp upper and lower left-edge segments spanning y/H in [0,0.05] and [0.95,1]."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Right-edge traction footprint",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies traction on the right edge; Sec. 4.4 describes the same cantilever's traction as applied at the center of that edge. Neither specifies the loaded span or resolves full-edge loading versus a localized central load.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform traction over the entire right edge, y/H in [0,1].",
        "Uniform traction over a centered patch, y/H in [0.45,0.55].",
        "Uniform traction over the two central boundary facets, y/H in [0.49,0.51].",
        "A center-node force representing 100 MPa over a one-element tributary area of 1 mm by 1 mm, giving 100 N."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Right-edge traction vector",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 supplies the traction magnitude but no direction or vector components. Fig. 3 contains the unavailable setup. The downward traction in Sec. 4.3 belongs to a different support and loading configuration.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward traction: (0,-100) MPa.",
        "Horizontal outward traction: (100,0) MPa.",
        "Traction directed 45 degrees downward and outward: (100/sqrt(2),-100/sqrt(2)) MPa."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design material near supports and loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 does not identify passive masks or state whether attachment and loading cells must remain solid. No pad dimensions or filtering treatment for such cells are supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; all elements remain designable.",
        "Keep a one-element-thick solid pad adjacent to the loaded boundary facets by fixing its raw densities to 1 before filtering.",
        "Keep one-element-thick solid regions adjacent to both the clamped boundary and loaded facets, enforcing physical density 1 after filtering."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial topology density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.4, 3.5 and 4.1 do not specify the initial densities for the elastic baseline. The uniform compositional initialization in Sec. 4.5 concerns a different problem.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every raw density to 0.5.",
        "Initialize every raw density to 1 and allow MMA to restore volume feasibility.",
        "Initialize with small spatial perturbations about 0.5, adjusted to retain mean density 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Unreported MMA parameters",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. 3.4 and 4 defer remaining MMA settings to Deetman (2025) defaults without identifying a software revision or giving numerical asymptote constants, slack penalties and subproblem tolerances.",
      "readings": [
        "Use asymptote initialization factor 0.5, expansion factor 1.2, contraction factor 0.7, slack penalty c=1000, d=0, and subproblem tolerance 1e-7.",
        "Use the same asymptote factors with slack penalty c=10000, d=0, and subproblem tolerance 1e-9."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Additional objective convergence criterion",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 3.5 says termination requires both design and objective changes below a tolerance. Sec. 4 instead specifies a 250-iteration cap or maximum density change at most 1e-5, without an objective-change test.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow Sec. 4: stop at 250 iterations or maximum raw-density change at most 1e-5, regardless of objective change.",
        "Also require relative elastic-compliance change at most 1e-5 for early termination, retaining the 250-iteration cap."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Elastic equilibrium and sensitivity linear-solve accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text names JAX and JAX-FEM but does not specify the linear solver, numerical precision or residual tolerances used to compute the baseline elastic displacement and associated sensitivities.",
      "readings": [
        "Use float64 sparse direct solves to approximately machine precision.",
        "Use float64 preconditioned conjugate-gradient solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-8.",
        "Use float32 preconditioned conjugate-gradient solves with relative residual tolerance 1e-5."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
